newsitem.title: CANADA: United Grain sets C$5.5 mln capital upgrade.
newsitem.headline: United Grain sets C$5.5 mln capital upgrade.

text.p: United Grain Growers Ltd said on Tuesday it plans a C$5.5 million upgrade to three of its existing primary elevators, UGG said in a statement.
"This allows UGG to become more competitive and offer improved customer service," UGG chief executive Brian Hayward said in a company statement.
This latest capital upgrade brings UGG's total capital investment in Prairie grain handling and crop input industries to C$128.7 million since 1993.
UGG's elevator in Redvers, Saskatchewan, will be expanded to handle 200,000 tonnes a year for a cost of C$2.9 million.
It's elevator in Killam, Alberta will be upgraded to handle 120,000 tonnes a year for a cost of C$1.85 million.
The elevators at Redvers and Killam are located along CP Rail System lines.
UGG's elevator in Dutton Siding, Manitoba, will be expanded to handle 100,000 tonnes a year for a cost of C$800,000. This facility is located along a Canadian National Railway Co line.
